description: Is it altcoin season? Daily Altcoin-Season indicator; the Layer-1 signal comes from weekly closes (methodology.version names the method). Returns BTC-, alt- and stablecoin dominance, the 4 Layer-1 signals, overall color (red/yellow/green) and Layer 2: altcoin_season_pct with altcoin_season_pct_basis and altcoin_season_pct_provenance (fields="full" names the missing coins), plus the CoinGecko snapshot of the 30 largest coins (field top50_snapshot). The `methodology` block in the payload defines inputs, weights and denominators. [Free tier]

fields.description: Omit for the default response, which carries `provenance` in short form (grade full/partial/thin, sources_used, sources_expected). 'full' adds the long form: sources_missing (named), sources (licence attribution names), grade_reason, as_of — plus per-part provenance where the composite has parts. A `thin` grade (under half the expected inputs) is never a basis for a verdict or a ranking.

name: arena_get_altcoin_season
title: Get Altcoin Season Snapshot
